verdict.rationale: Square documents a List Payouts endpoint in its Payouts API, and offers agent-friendly access through an official MCP server, an llms.txt file, a TypeScript SDK and webhooks. That covers an agent pulling payouts. However, the evidence never shows an endpoint for listing payments or transactions (the SDK example only creates a payment), nor any guidance on payout-entry breakdowns or reconciling against a ledger. Missing for 10: documented transaction/payment listing for daily takings, payout entry or fee breakdown for reconciliation, accounting/ledger integration evidence, hands-on corroboration of an agent reconciliation workflow.
